clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Good evening, Northside Clinic. How can I help?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: Hi, I'd like a check-up for Tuesday morning.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: One moment while I check what is genuinely free.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: I can offer 10:30 with Anna, or 11:30 with Dev. Which suits you?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: 10:30 with Anna, please.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Done: Tuesday at 10:30 with Anna. I'm texting you a confirmation now.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Northside Clinic, how can I help?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: I need to move my Wednesday 2pm appointment.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: I can see it. Thursday at 11:00 is free. Would that work?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: Yes, that's fine.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Moved to Thursday 11:00. Your old slot is released.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Wednesday 14:00 has been offered to someone on the waitlist.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Thanks for calling Northside Clinic. The office is closed, but I can book you in.

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: A cleaning, early in the week if possible.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Monday 11:00 or Tuesday 09:00 are both free. Which would you like?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: Tuesday at nine.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Booked for Tuesday 09:00. A confirmation text is on its way.

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: I need a double appointment on Thursday.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: A double needs the senior clinician and Room 2 together for 60 minutes. Checking both.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: They are only free together from 12:00. Shall I book 12:00 to 13:00?

clips.speaker: caller
clips.text: Yes, please.

clips.speaker: agent
clips.text: Booked. Both are reserved and a confirmation is on its way.
